prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. Four adult friends aged 27 to 39 pause on a safe broad mountain trail, sharing an amused conversation while looking at the landscape. They wear practical unbranded hiking layers and small backpacks. Keep all four together as a clear central group, with mountains providing context. Use diffuse morning light, believable terrain, and natural body posture. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The four adult hikers have distinctly different appearances: a clean-shaven blond man with a square face; a woman with a short dark pixie haircut and round face; a red-haired woman with braided hair and freckles; and a clean-shaven man with dark wavy hair and oval glasses. Exact wide horizontal 16:9. Use a genuinely wide environmental view, all four grouped compactly within central 55 percent of width with natural path and landscape at both sides. Continuous real photograph from top to bottom. No gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing, artificial blur band, or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption space consists only of normal clothing, furniture or scenery that belongs naturally to the real scene.

CORRECTION: Use a more distant wide environmental photograph. The four hikers stand close together in a compact central group; all their arms and hands stay close to their torsos or hold backpack straps. Nobody points, reaches outward, or extends any arm toward the margins. All four faces, every visible hand, and the full shared interaction must remain completely inside the central 4:3 crop; leave at least 20 percent of width on each side as open mountain scenery. Continuous real photograph from top to bottom. No gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing, artificial blur band, or synthetic empty caption band.
review: Reviewed replacement wide photograph: four distinct adult hikers stand as a compact full-body group on a broad mountain path, hands held at backpack straps near torsos. All four faces, all visible hands and the full interaction remain inside the central 4:3 and 1.65 crops. Landscape margins generous; believable anatomy and practical clothing, no text.
